neighbours.label: a minimizer with even, only or not: even a little, even slightly, if only briefly, remotely, the slightest, as opposed to the same words stating plain amounts
fire: I hope that even a tiny bit of this helps you.
Maria, who was more than a little annoyed, walked out.
If the dose is even slightly wrong, the test fails.
I do not believe him. Not even a little.
The storm stopped the ferry, if only temporarily.
Was any of it even remotely funny?
He did not show the slightest interest in the plan.
She was not in the least bit surprised.
quiet: I hope that the tiny package reaches you.
Maria, who was a little girl then, walked out.
If the dose is large, the test takes longer.
I do not have a car. I have a bicycle.
The storm stopped the ferry for the whole week.
Was any of it sold at the shop?
He showed a little cheese and some bread to the guests.
She bought a bit of string at the market.

short: minimizer (even a little, if only briefly)
